itemDisplayName: Azure AI Gateway with Microsoft Foundry models
description: Deploy Azure AI Gateway and Microsoft Foundry with gpt-5.4, gpt-5.3-codex, and gpt-5.4-mini model deployments, managed-identity access, canonical routing aliases, token and cost limits, and content safety. Optionally export telemetry to Application Insights without capturing payloads.
summary: Deploy Azure AI Gateway and three Microsoft Foundry models with managed identity, failover aliases, governance policies, and optional Application Insights.
